44604.title: Move up reorders a part within its line and persists

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (Work Order Lines: Create & Edit, Full View).

2. Open, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab, a line that carries two or more parts. Each part row has a 6-dots drag handle (the "drag_indicator" icon) at its far left; a part is reordered by dragging that handle up or down.
custom_preconds.text:
1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (Work Order Lines: Create & Edit, Full View).
2. Open, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab, a line that carries two or more parts. Each part row has a 6-dots drag handle (the "drag_indicator" icon) at its far left; a part is reordered by dragging that handle up or down.

blocks: 1. On the work order's Lines tab, drag a part by its 6-dots drag handle to a new position within its line.
2. Reload the page to confirm the new order persists, then view the invoice and the PDF order.
3. Use the Undo action in the toast that appears after the drop.
custom_steps.text:
1. On the work order's Lines tab, drag a part by its 6-dots drag handle to a new position within its line.
2. Reload the page to confirm the new order persists, then view the invoice and the PDF order.
3. Use the Undo action in the toast that appears after the drop.

blocks: 1. Dragging a part by its drag handle reorders it within its line, and the new order persists across reloads.
2. After the drop a confirmation toast appears reading "Part order updated." and offers an Undo action; a drop can be undone (using Undo reverts the reorder).
3. The reordered sequence is reflected in the invoice and the PDF order.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 (Simple Flow V2, Story 20 - reordering parts within a line) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026).
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.
